title: SNATCH – Citrus
description:
Snatch Citrus Strong is a slimmed all white nicotine pouch with a combined taste of citrus and menthol delivered with a nicotine strength of 16mg/g.

The black can comes packed with 20 slimmed 100% tobacco free pouches that sits perfectly under your lip. The semi-moist portions provides a comfortable drip and release of both taste and nicotine. Since all pouches are all white, you won’t have to worry about discoloring your teeth.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,2

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Manufacturer: Consumer Brands International
